session_note: Cloud-agent session on branch cursor/semaev-2015-audit-program-5b8b, 2026-09-13. The paper was fetched because this program had been citing it as KN-LIT-009, an abstract-level stub marked 'Full paper not read', while simultaneously depending on its Section 4.3 model as the frozen reference curve 'HEUR-SEMAEV-2015-4.3' in GOAL-RELN-001 and GOAL-ICEX-001 protocols, and measuring its Assumption 1 quantity in GOAL-DREG-001. Reading it converts a pointer into a citable source (AGENTS.md core rule 9).

attempts.purpose: Freeze the full text of Semaev's 2015 characteristic-2 summation-polynomial algorithm: the chained S_3 system (eq. 5), Assumption 1 (d_F4 <= 4), Assumption 2, the Section 4.3 success-probability model (eq. 11), the two-stage cost balance (eqs. 15-17) and Tables 1-3
attempts.reason: Vendored under the paper's CC BY 4.0 licence. Two fetches were made a minute apart and produced identical sha256 values, so the copy in the repository is the copy that was read.

attempts.purpose: Establish which revision the PDF is, the licence, and the author's own note on what the revision changed
attempts.reason: Bytes deliberately NOT vendored: the landing page is site chrome around the paper, not the paper. This entry is a retrieval receipt, so a later session re-fetching the URL can tell from a changed sha256 that the page moved.

local_artifacts.note: Row-wise transcription of Tables 1-3, needed because pdfminer reflows the table bodies by column. Every cell confirmed against a second extraction with pypdf. Includes arithmetic re-derived from the paper's own formulas, marked as internal-consistency checks and not as measurements by this program.
